verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a 'Search' entry in Trello's REST API reference, which suggests Trello has its own search capability. Nothing documents what it covers (cards, comments, attachments or docs), how fast it is, or how accurate its results are. missing for 10: documented search scope across tasks, docs and comments, an in-app search experience, evidence of speed and accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
